integrity: Minimality and classification are established by exhaustive finite generation of every boundary-free binary word through length 30. The two witnesses and all single-letter insertions are separately checked using least-period computations. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies only the shortest extremal \(\frac{8}{3}\)-free binary words. It does not decide existence for thresholds above \(\frac{8}{3}\) or classify longer extremal words.
title: Shortest extremal \(\frac{8}{3}\)-free binary words
